scope: The cosmic mantle and the tent of heaven: the high priest's robe as the cosmos (cf. Philo, De vita Mosis 2.135, Josephus, Antiquities 3.180–187), the ancient world-picture whole.
why_seated: Eisler's scholarship, public domain (2026-11-12); the robe as cosmos joins the Josephus–Philo loci of the narrative.
